description: This file contains unit tests for the ClaimDao class related to ClaimExpense entities in the OrangeHRM system. It verifies functionalities such as saving, retrieving, listing, and deleting claim expenses in the context of the Claim module.

classes.name: ClaimDaoExpenseTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing ClaimDao methods related to ClaimExpense entities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, instantiates the ClaimDao object, and loads fixture data.

methods.name: testSaveClaimExpense
methods.description: Tests saving a new ClaimExpense and verifies the assigned ID.

methods.name: testGetClaimExpenseById
methods.description: Tests retrieving a ClaimExpense by its ID.

methods.name: testGetClaimExpenseList
methods.description: Tests listing ClaimExpenses filtered by claim request ID.

methods.name: testDeleteClaimExpense
methods.description: Tests deleting ClaimExpenses associated with a specific claim request ID.
